summary: INV-03 Accept matching invitation: implemented POST /api/v1/invitations/accept validating incoming single-use token against SHA-256 hash in project_invitations under row-level FOR UPDATE lock. Enforces strict email match between authenticated session and invitation recipient (mismatch returns 403 EMAIL_MISMATCH without membership creation), handles expired tokens (transitioning status to expired and returning 400 INVITATION_EXPIRED), and atomically updates invitation status to accepted while upserting active project_memberships. All automated integration tests pass against local PostgreSQL.
limitations: Requires active authenticated session with verified email.
